description: CABLE | Software Engineer (early team) | Sydney, Australia (ON-SITE) | Full-time | https://jobs.cable.energy/roles/3e2cd174-71f5-80ae-a1d2-db8b... We're Australia's battery-backed electricity company. We fund, install and operate batteries on-site at small businesses, then supply their power at a firm, flat rate 20–40% below incumbents, making the economics work by optimising those batteries against wholesale prices. We're live with real customers. Team of six, backed by Systemiq and Black Nova; engineering includes Casey, who previously led Google engineering in Paris and Google Maps in Sydney. We're AI-native: engineers, energy specialists and go-to-market colleagues all ship with coding agents. Each engineer owns a product end to end, from the commercial problem through to production. Flat structure, lots of ownership. Areas you could own: * Customer experience: quoting, onboarding and the customer app * Metering and billing: turning high-volume interval data into accurate bills * Energy-market and battery data: the market, weather and telemetry pipelines behind our decisions * The agent-driven development platform the whole team builds on Stack: TypeScript, React, Postgres, serverless. Intro chat, system design, an agentic build, then a day with the team. Apply at https://jobs.cable.energy/roles/3e2cd174-71f5-80ae-a1d2-db8b... or email theo@cable.energy.
